recommendation: Keep this focused source fix. Broader NutritionOrder example cleanup from later model revisions, if needed, should be handled under a separate issue trail rather than expanding FHIR-4001 beyond the product-name request.
issue_request: FHIR-4001 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for DSTU1 and requested changing EnteralFormula.baseFormulaName to a product-name element because product name better captured the intended product or brand and distinguished it from formula type.
initial_application: The historical NutritionOrder StructureDefinition carried committee notes for [#4000][#4001][#4002] saying to change "...name" to "...productName", and the pre-current enteral formula element was NutritionOrder.enteralFormula.baseFormulaProductName. Commit c83bf77567 later revised NutritionOrder so the authoritative element became NutritionOrder.enteralFormula.productName, but two active examples still used baseFormulaProductName before this reconciliation.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively includes NutritionOrder, and list-NutritionOrder-examples.xml lists the enteral bolus and enteral cycled examples. The remaining baseFormulaProductName entries in fhir.ini are R4/R5-to-R6 change mappings to the current productName element, not current example content. Zulip and Confluence searches found no evidence conflicting with the Jira/source conclusion.
reconciliation: Changed source/nutritionorder/nutritionorder-example-enteralbolus.xml and source/nutritionorder/nutritionorder-example-enteralcycled.xml to use <productName> for the existing enteral formula product values.
source_changes: source/nutritionorder/nutritionorder-example-enteralbolus.xml: replaced baseFormulaProductName with productName for the Acme High Protein Formula value.
source/nutritionorder/nutritionorder-example-enteralcycled.xml: replaced baseFormulaProductName with productName for the Acme Diabetes Formula value.

related_jiras.note: The same historical committee note grouped supplement name-to-productName with this enteral formula rename.
The same historical committee note grouped additive name-to-productName with this enteral formula rename.
